_comment: Card ownership, granted by the controller. launch_gate reads launch_block_granted.
Idle is not free: a card's owner is the job still running or the one the controller
has queued, never the instantaneous nvidia-smi row. Three collisions on 2026-09-01
came from reading an idle card as an available one.
why_not_granted: The 7-card block is not granted because the launch is not ready: the corpus build is unfinished, mix epochs are still ESTIMATED, and no world=7 memory peak exists. Granting the block now would idle seven cards behind a NO-GO gate.

next_grant.for: world=7 peak memory, b32 and b16+accum2, 30 steps each
next_grant.note: no 6-card substitute: the DDP bucket grows with world, so a 6-card peak cannot answer whether b32 fits at 7
